<div class="card-body">
'''Caller''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">コーラー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍、ジャワに配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にあって行動規制ボルトにコントロールされているドロイドを１体盗むことができる。ドロイドを盗んだなら、行動規制ボルトは所有者の手札に戻る。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-34o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">行動規制ボルトに命令するための携帯装置。コーラーと行動規制ボルトは１対１で対応している。銀河規模で広く使われており、“行動規制ボルト起動器”とも呼ばれている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Caller.

'''Card text:''' May deploy on a Rebel or Jawa. During your control phase, you may steal one droid at the same location that is controlled by a restraining bolt. If you steal the droid, return the restraining bolt to its owner's hand.

'''Lore:''' A handheld device for commanding a restraining bolt. Each caller corresponds to one restraining bolt. Widely used across the galaxy, it is also called a restraining bolt activator.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Caller]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
